plot_local.fact: Thane Hearthless killed Hollow Choir disciple Brother Quell on the Spine Road eleven days ago and harvested his Lagging Shadow power. The Choir has not found the body.
The Choir needs Pip alive and dreaming: each night he dreams in the Quiet Rooms, they map more of the way to Aldrumm's true heart (Choir clock ticks once per day).

lore.fact: Thane Hearthless carries Aldrumm's blood (Hearthblood). Nobody in Godbones knows yet.
Pip's word is a Marrowtongue hearth-word (kindling / home-fire). Mother Gristle's cheek scar is the same word, burned in when she learned it.

session_events.fact: Deacon Vane, helped by two market porters, is carrying the unconscious Pip up the climb toward the Chapel of the Long Wake. She did not notice Thane's wrist.

Thane spoke Pip's word (a hearth-word of Marrowtongue) untutored in Gristle's doorway, reaching for Aldrumm. Nat 20: Aldrumm answered and paid half the Toll. Gristle's cold stove roared alight and the word-shaped burn scar on her cheek glowed. The Stirring rose to 1.
The Chapel bell stopped. Deacon Vane took Pip into the Chapel's Quiet Rooms. Thane chose to stay and seek a real Marrowtongue apprenticeship from Gristle rather than chase the procession.

Training day two: Thane's first binding-word test misfired (bound his own jaw); he used the Stopping. By evening he was proficient and could bind reliably. At dusk Deacon Ilsabet Vane knocked at the front of Gristle's shop, asking about the stove that relit itself.

Thane reached for Aldrumm a second time to bind Deacon Vane to her oath (cast 18 vs DC 15, success). Calling the god moved the Stirring +2 (now 3/6), crossing 2: tonight the whole town shares a dream of Aldrumm. His blood-oath to Gristle burned him for 6 HP. The Toll came up as Collapse (0 HP); the working is held on his tongue, not yet tied off.

player_choices.fact: Thane swore on his Hearthblood to Mother Gristle that when he wakes Aldrumm, he will wake him slow, so the god does not roll over the town. In return she teaches him Marrowtongue.
